mechanism: Albendazole induces CYP2B6 and CYP3A4, potentially reducing bupropion plasma concentrations and efficacy; bupropion may also lower albendazole levels through enzyme induction.
action: Monitor for reduced antidepressant efficacy; bupropion dose adjustment may be needed; consider seizure risk given bupropion's dose-dependent seizure potential and metabolic changes.
